title: Tessa bundle manifest
description: The machine-readable manifest.yaml of a Tessa bundle: everything Tessa needs to test a running app from outside. Placeholders ${NAME} stand in for every secret. Unknown top-level keys are errors; unknown keys inside a section are kept. This schema checks shape only: Tessa also checks on upload that every reference resolves (feature interfaces, roles and flags, truth source and seed variables, ids unique) and that every ${NAME} placeholder is declared in environment. The same bundle carries oracle/<name>.yaml (OracleSidecar), flows/<id>.yaml (Flow) and env.template (EnvTemplate), and may carry the optional file mutants.yaml (MutantsSidecar, a list of MutantFields entries written in the Mutants round-trip); their formats are defined under $defs.

EnvTemplate.title: env.template
EnvTemplate.description: Format of env.template: plain text, one variable per line as NAME=value, where NAME matches [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]* and value is empty or a single token without whitespace (use <describe-it> for a secret, or a harmless example for a non-secret). The purpose of a variable goes in a comment line starting with # directly above it, or in a trailing comment after whitespace and #. Blank lines are allowed. Every environment entry of the manifest has exactly one line, and no other names appear. Never put a real value in this file.
examples:
# Base URL of the QA deployment
GRACIE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080

ADMIN_TOKEN=<admin-api-token>  # API token of the admin role

MutantsSidecar.title: mutants.yaml
MutantsSidecar.description: Format of the optional file mutants.yaml: one YAML list, one entry per known bug, each validated against MutantFields. Upload imports every entry as a mutant with status registered; an entry is identified by its name, so uploading the same name again updates it instead of adding a second one.
